1. Requirements

Warning

Usage

Useful software

Tip

These are useful libraries and software

  • Climate Data Operator (CDO) - software to perform operations on climate data from the command line. Supports netCDF 3/4 formats.

  • Ncview - is a tool to visually inspect netCDF (.nc) files.
